name: Final server integration checks
command: export PATH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH"; vp test run apps/server/src/provider/Layers/PiAdapter.test.ts apps/server/src/provider/Layers/PiAdapter.integration.test.ts apps/server/src/provider/Layers/PiRuntimeNormalization.test.ts apps/server/src/provider/Layers/PiRpcClient.test.ts apps/server/src/provider/Drivers/PiDriver.test.ts apps/server/src/provider/Layers/PiProvider.test.ts apps/server/src/orchestration/Layers/ProviderCommandReactor.test.ts && node --input-type=module -e 'import {spawnSync} from "node:child_process"; import {writeFileSync} from "node:fs"; const r=spawnSync("tsc",["--noEmit","-p","apps/server/tsconfig.json"],{encoding:"utf8",maxBuffer:20_000_000}); const out=(r.stdout??"")+(r.stderr??""); writeFileSync("/tmp/t3-pi-server-final-typecheck.log",out); console.log("SERVER_TYPECHECK_EXIT="+r.status); console.log(out.split("\n").filter(l=>l.includes("error TS")).join("\n")); process.exitCode=r.status??1;'
